_doc: One headless Claude Code run per experiment, against slow-lab behind the logging proxy. env = extra environment for claude; server_timeout_ms = per-server 'timeout' in the MCP config; outer_s = our own kill timer. Every timer claim is from code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp and /env-vars, fetched 19 Oct 2026; these runs check them on Claude Code itself. Auto-backgrounding is turned off (CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS=0) except in E1, so each run isolates one timer.

E1-background.what: a 150 s silent call with all defaults: does it move to a background task at 2 min?
E1-background.prompt: Call the wait_seconds tool once with seconds=150. While waiting, do nothing else. When it settles, report exactly what you saw, quoting any message verbatim.

E2-tool-timeout-env.prompt: Call the hang tool once. If it fails, do not retry. Report the exact error message verbatim.

E3-server-timeout.what: hang with a per-server timeout of 60000 in the MCP config
E3-server-timeout.prompt: Call the hang tool once. If it fails, do not retry. Report the exact error message verbatim.

E4-idle-timeout.prompt: Call the hang tool once. If it fails, do not retry. Report the exact error message verbatim.

E5-idle-with-progress.what: 150 s call that reports progress every 10 s, idle window 60 s: does progress keep it alive?
E5-idle-with-progress.prompt: Call the wait_seconds tool once with seconds=150 and progress_every=10. If it fails, do not retry. Report the result or the exact error message verbatim.

E6-idle-silent.what: the same 150 s call with no progress, idle window 60 s
E6-idle-silent.prompt: Call the wait_seconds tool once with seconds=150. If it fails, do not retry. Report the result or the exact error message verbatim.

E7-hard-limit-with-progress.what: per-server timeout 60000 plus progress every 10 s: progress should NOT extend a hard limit
E7-hard-limit-with-progress.prompt: Call the wait_seconds tool once with seconds=150 and progress_every=10. If it fails, do not retry. Report the result or the exact error message verbatim.

E8-defaults-hang.what: hang with every default: nothing should stop it for 6 minutes (stdio idle default is 30 min)
E8-defaults-hang.prompt: Call the hang tool once. If it fails, do not retry. Report the exact error message verbatim.
